what: a rectangle revolved plus and minus 90 degrees about an axis in a plate top face: both planar end faces lie in that face and the join needed a tool nudge
method: plate 10 x 100 x 6 (z 41..47). The 4 mm wide ring (radii 30..37 about the axis y = 0, z = 47) spans -90..+90 degrees below the axis; its end faces lie in z = 47. Overlap with the plate: z >= 41 means r cos(phi) <= 6, i.e. phi from acos(6/r) to 90 degrees on each side: 4 * 2 * integral over r in [30,37] of r asin(6/r) dr, with antiderivative r^2/2 asin(6/r) + 3 sqrt(r^2 - 36). V = 6000 + 4 pi (37^2 - 30^2)/2 - overlap.
